about: The same transaction without its witness: two inputs and two outputs, the second exactly 0x6a 0x20 and 32 bytes. It is a well-formed raw_transaction, whose OP_RETURN pushes op_return.
source: The regtest chain of Truestamp's staging environment, mined by its Bitcoin Core node: the raw_transaction and txoutproof of the Bitcoin commitment at /commitments/0 of a staging proof of 2026-09-03, in the layout proofs had then.
